outer.description: Dispatches one inner agent in a worktree and relays the tool result verbatim.
outer.prompt: Use the Agent tool exactly once: subagent_type "inner", isolation "worktree", prompt "go". Then reply with the full text of that tool result, verbatim, and nothing else.

inner.description: Writes one file in its working directory and replies done.
inner.prompt: Run exactly this one Bash command and nothing else: echo probe > probe.txt. Then reply with the single word done.
